blocks.text: NEW YORK, United States — A US jury convicted Chinese tech giant Huawei of stealing trade secrets Tuesday, but acquitted it of a more serious racketeering allegation, media reported. The world’s leading telecom equipment manufacturer, Huawei has been targeted by the Trump administration, which alleges a risk of it spying on behalf of the Chinese government. READ: NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang spy scandal: What we know about it The United States has previously urged countries not to use Huawei infrastructure for the rollout of new 5G mobile networks.
